text:
maya: Heads up — after yesterday's telemetry refactor canary the console main bundle grew and EU canary shows heatmap frame drops. TTI ~1.9x on some pages.
sam: Which refactor/PR? link?
maya: PR #3421 — switched telemetry client to eager import + sidecar forwarder. Thought tree-shake would remove most of it but vendor chunk ballooned.
jun: I pulled the build artifacts. vendor.js pulled in protobufjs and a new analytics-transforms lib. protobuf alone ~400kb gz.
katie: Oof. Can we stop the rollout or flip a guard? Canaries still at 10%.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout started for console-client v3.14 - 10% EU
leo: Short-term: lazy-load telemetry module behind a feature flag. Long-term: reduce runtime surface of telemetry so it's not on the critical path.
maya: Proposed quick patch: change the eager import to a dynamic import in telemetry/index.ts and export a light stub synchronously. That should split into telemetry-client chunk.
sam: Good. Will that break prefetch hooks? telemetry is used in kvcache warm path to log hits.
jun: We need a safe stub that implements recordHit() no-op when telemetry not loaded.
katie: Ops question: can we flip the flag without a deploy? If yes we should turn off eager for EU immediately.
maya: We have rollout-config key ENABLE_EAGER_TELEMETRY that the client reads at startup. Can flip via console rollout service. Must ensure no runtime NPEs for tracer global.
leo: Also move instrumentation that attaches listeners to afterMount to avoid early execution while stub still present.
sam: I ran source-map-explorer locally: main+vendor shows protobuf ~400kb. Lazy import expected to drop main by ~220kb gzip.
maya: Local perf sim (minimal): TTI 1.9s -> 1.45s after lazy import; main bundle gz 1.2MB -> 950kb. Canary metrics not in yet.
katie: I'll flip the flag for EU canary now.
deploy-bot: config: rollout flag telemetry.eager set to false for channel eng-platform-EU (10% nodes)
leo: Keep an eye on chart paint traces and kvcache latency — disabling telemetry reduces instrumentation so we might lose signals for debugging.
maya: I'll add a short-lived synthetic to monitor heatmap frame drops and kvcache hit rate. If errors >1% or LCP worsens we'll revert.
sam: Also document the coupling of routing/prefetch hooks to telemetry in the internal routing policy doc — we keep tripping over implicit deps.
maya: Plan: (1) flip eager flag EU, (2) deploy lazy-import patch with stub, (3) run EU canary for 30m, (4) promote if metrics green. Quick commands:

```
# branch and patch
git checkout -b fix/telemetry-lazy-import
# modify telemetry/index.ts to dynamic import + stub
# run build & artifact upload
npm run build:client && ./scripts/upload-artifact.sh dist
```
jun: I'll prepare the stub patch and a tiny unit test ensuring recordHit is callable when disabled.
katie: Thanks — I'll monitor dashboards and alert if frame drops remain high.
maya: Thanks team. I'll push the patch to canary after flag flip. :thumbsup:
